***

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(glue)
library(gt)
library(UpSetR)
library(patchwork)
library(ggrepel)
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "tensorqtl_functions.R"))
in_dir       <- params$in_dir
ind_dir      <- params$ind_dir
l1_types     <- strsplit(params$l1_types, ",")[[1]]
l2_types     <- strsplit(params$l2_types, ",")[[1]]
exp_pcs      <- as.numeric(strsplit(params$exp_pcs, ",")[[1]])
geno_pc      <- as.numeric(params$geno_pc)
norm_methods <- strsplit(params$norm_methods, ",")[[1]]
final_norm   <- norm_methods[1]   # results use the first norm method in config
window_kb    <- as.numeric(params$window) / 1000
eqtl_fdr     <- as.numeric(params$eqtl_fdr)
pc_pairs     <- strsplit(strsplit(params$exp_pc_map, ",")[[1]], ":")
exp_pc_map   <- setNames(as.numeric(map_chr(pc_pairs, 2)), map_chr(pc_pairs, 1))
```

## TensorQTL pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

We used [tensorQTL](https://github.com/broadinstitute/tensorqtl) to generate eQTL.
The citation for tensorQTL is [Taylor-Weiner et al. 2019 (DOI:10.1186/s13059-019-1836-7)](https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13059-019-1836-7).

***

1. `prep_tensorQTL_input`: Munge cell-specific pseudobulk gExp and covariate data into TensorQTL-ready format
2. `zip_pblk_cnts`: bgzip and index pseudobulk gExp data
3. `convert_genotypes`: Convert genotypes into TensorQTL-ready plink 2 format
4. `split_covariates`: Generate covariate files for geno_pc and exp_pc combinations
5. `tensorqtl_nom`: Run TensorQTL to detect cis-eQTL nominal p-values
6. `tensorqtl_perm`: Run TensorQTL to detect cis-eQTL via permutations
7. `tensorqtl_independent`: Run TensorQTL to detect conditionally independent variants

***

```{r, summary_table_L1, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
                             norm_methods = sort(norm_methods))
```

#### Pie Chart

+ Showing plots for geno PCs = `r geno_pc`, Exp PCs = `exp_pc_map`, norm method = '`r final_norm`'

```{r, pie_chart, results='asis', echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(7.5,7.5) }
gene_cell <- eqtls_all %>%
  distinct(phenotype_id, cell_type)

gene_counts <- gene_cell %>%
  count(phenotype_id) %>%
  count(n)  # number of cell types per gene

pie_dat <- gene_counts %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0(n, " cell type", ifelse(n > 1, "s", "")),
    count = nn
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate cumulative fraction for positioning labels
    fraction = count / sum(count),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
    midpoint = (ymax + ymin) / 2
  )

ggplot(pie_dat, aes(ymax = ymax, ymin = ymin, xmax = 1, xmin = 0, fill = label)) +
  geom_rect(color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text_repel(aes(
    x = 1.1,
    y = midpoint,
    label = count
  ),
  nudge_x = 0.05,
  segment.color = "grey50",
  segment.size = 0.5,
  show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "Cell type sharing",
    title = "Shared eGenes across cell types"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

```

##### SNPs

+ Showing tables for geno PCs = `r geno_pc`, Exp PCs = `exp_pc_map`, norm method = '`r final_norm`'

***

```{r, eQTL_independent_snps, results='asis', echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
multi_eqtls <- all_eqtls %>%
  filter(rank <= 3) %>%   # only keep primary/secondary/tertiary
  select(cell_type, gene = phenotype_id, variant_id, af, pval_perm, rank) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = rank,
    values_from = c(variant_id, af, pval_perm),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{rank}"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(variant_id_2)) %>%  # keep only genes with >1 SNP
  rename(primary_snp = variant_id_1,
         second_snp  = variant_id_2,
         third_snp   = variant_id_3,
         af_primary = af_1,
         af_second  = af_2,
         af_third   = af_3,
         pval_perm_primary = pval_perm_1,
         pval_perm_second  = pval_perm_2,
         pval_perm_third   = pval_perm_3)

multi_eqtls_tbl <- multi_eqtls %>%
  # Some weird unicode issues here
    mutate(across(starts_with("pval_perm"), ~ .x %>%
    gsub("<U\\+00D7>", "×", ., perl = TRUE) %>%
    gsub("<U\\+2212>", "−", ., perl = TRUE))) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 5. Genes with multiple independent eQTL per cell type"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    cell_type          = "Cell Type",
    gene               = "Gene",
    primary_snp        = "SNP",
    second_snp         = "SNP",
    third_snp          = "SNP",
    af_primary         = "AF",
    af_second          = "AF",
    af_third           = "AF",
    pval_perm_primary  = "Perm P",
    pval_perm_second   = "Perm P",
    pval_perm_third    = "Perm P"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Primary",
    columns = c(primary_snp, af_primary, pval_perm_primary)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Secondary",
    columns = c(second_snp, af_second, pval_perm_second)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Tertiary",
    columns = c(third_snp, af_third, pval_perm_third)
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = starts_with("af_"),
    decimals = 3
  ) %>%
  fmt_scientific(
    columns = starts_with("pval_perm"),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  gt_style()
print(multi_eqtls_tbl)
```

### Combined {.tabset}

#### Shared

+ Showing plots for geno PCs = `r geno_pc`, Exp PCs = `exp_pc_map`, norm method = '`r final_norm`'

***

```{r, eqtl_combined_plt, results='asis', echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(6,4)}
# L1 cell types with L2 subclusters
cell_types_L2 <- l2_types
cell_types_L1 <- l1_types[l1_types %in% sub("-[^-]+$", "", cell_types_L2)]

eqtl_L1 <- map_dfr(
  cell_types_L1,
  ~ read_egenes(
      cell_type   = .x,
      in_dir      = in_dir,
      norm_method = final_norm,
      geno_pc     = geno_pc,
      exp_pc      = exp_pc_map[[.x]],
      fdr         = eqtl_fdr
    )
)

eqtl_L2 <- map_dfr(
  cell_types_L2,
  ~ read_egenes(
      cell_type   = .x,
      in_dir      = in_dir,
      norm_method = final_norm,
      geno_pc     = geno_pc,
      exp_pc      = exp_pc_map[[.x]],
      fdr         = eqtl_fdr
    )
)

eqtl_all <- bind_rows(eqtl_L1, eqtl_L2)

# Separate into lists
egenes_L1 <- eqtl_all %>% filter(cell_type %in% cell_types_L1)
egenes_L2 <- eqtl_all %>% filter(cell_type %in% cell_types_L2)

# Group L2 subtypes under their parent L1 type
egenes_L2 <- egenes_L2 %>%
  mutate(parent = sub("-[^-]+$", "", cell_type))

# Compare sets per parent
comparison_tbl <- map_dfr(cell_types_L1, function(ct) {
  egenes_ct_L1 <- egenes_L1 %>% filter(cell_type == ct) %>% pull(phenotype_id) %>% unique()
  egenes_ct_L2 <- egenes_L2 %>% filter(parent == ct) %>% pull(phenotype_id) %>% unique()

  shared     <- intersect(egenes_ct_L1, egenes_ct_L2)
  unique_L1  <- setdiff(egenes_ct_L1, egenes_ct_L2)
  unique_L2  <- setdiff(egenes_ct_L2, egenes_ct_L1)

  tibble(
    cell_type = ct,
    unique_L1 = length(unique_L1),
    shared    = length(shared),
    unique_L2 = length(unique_L2)
  )
})

# Plot
comparison_long <- comparison_tbl %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(unique_L1, shared, unique_L2),
             names_to = "category",
             values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category,
                           levels = c("unique_L2", "shared", "unique_L1"))) %>%  # <-- set order
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  mutate(prop = count / sum(count))

ggplot(comparison_long, aes(x = prop, y = fct_rev(cell_type), fill = category)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", color = "black", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("unique_L1" = "#66C2A5",
                               "shared"    = "#B2DF8A",
                               "unique_L2" = "gray70"),
                    labels = c("unique_L1" = "Cell type",
                               "shared"    = "Shared",
                               "unique_L2" = "Sub-cluster"),
                    breaks = c("unique_L1", "shared", "unique_L2")) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of eGenes found in cell types and sub-clusters",
       y = NULL,
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"))
```

#### Counts CT {.tabset}

+ Showing counts for geno PCs = `r geno_pc`, Exp PCs = `exp_pc_map`, norm method = '`r final_norm`'

***

```{r, cnts_cell_tpe, results='asis', echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(5,3) }
cell_types_all <- c(l1_types, l2_types)

# Build all file paths
summary_tbl <- map_dfr(cell_types_all, function(ct) {

  expPC <- exp_pc_map[[ct]]

  log_file <- paste0(tqtl_dir(in_dir, ct, final_norm, geno_pc, expPC),
                     ct, '_', final_norm, '_perm.cis_qtl.txt.gz')

  if (!file.exists(log_file)) {
    message("File missing: ", log_file)
    return(tibble(
      cell_type = ct,
      total_sig_eqtl = NA_integer_,
      unique_eQTL = NA_integer_,
      unique_eGenes = NA_integer_,
      top_eQTL = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  df <- read_tsv(log_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(qval < eqtl_fdr)

  # Total significant eQTLs
  total_sig_eqtl <- nrow(df)

  # Unique variant-gene pairs
  unique_eQTL <- df %>% distinct(variant_id, phenotype_id) %>% nrow()

  # Unique eGenes
  unique_eGenes <- df %>% distinct(phenotype_id) %>% nrow()

  # Top eQTL per gene (smallest qval per phenotype_id)
  top_eQTL <- df %>%
    group_by(phenotype_id) %>%
    slice_min(qval, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    nrow()

  tibble(
    cell_type = ct,
    total_sig_eqtl = total_sig_eqtl,
    unique_eQTL = unique_eQTL,
    unique_eGenes = unique_eGenes,
    top_eQTL = top_eQTL
  )
})

total_row <- tibble(
  cell_type = "Total",
  total_sig_eqtl = sum(summary_tbl$total_sig_eqtl),
  unique_eQTL    = sum(summary_tbl$unique_eQTL),        # sum across cell types
  unique_eGenes  = sum(summary_tbl$unique_eGenes),      # sum across cell types
  top_eQTL       = sum(summary_tbl$top_eQTL)
)

# Bind to original table
tbl_totals <- bind_rows(summary_tbl, total_row)
tbl_totals

```

***

#### Counts All

+ Showing counts for geno PCs = `r geno_pc`, Exp PCs = `exp_pc_map`, norm method = '`r final_norm`'

***

```{r, cnts_total, results='asis', echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(5,3) }
# Build all file paths
perm_files <- expand_grid(cell_type = cell_types_all,
                          norm_method = final_norm,
                          genPC = geno_pc) %>%
  mutate(expPC = exp_pc_map[cell_type],
         log_file = paste0(tqtl_dir(in_dir, cell_type, norm_method, genPC, expPC),
                           cell_type, "_", norm_method, "_perm.cis_qtl.txt.gz"))

# Read and combine all results
perm_results <- perm_files %>%
  mutate(data = map(log_file, ~ read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                      mutate(cell_type = cur_data()$cell_type,
                             norm_method = cur_data()$norm_method,
                             genPC = cur_data()$genPC,
                             expPC = cur_data()$expPC))) %>%
  pull(data) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Filter significant results
sig_eqtl <- perm_results %>% filter(qval < eqtl_fdr)

# Summaries
summary_tbl <- tibble(
  total_sig_eqtl = nrow(sig_eqtl),
  unique_eGenes  = n_distinct(sig_eqtl$phenotype_id),
  unique_eQTL    = n_distinct(paste(sig_eqtl$phenotype_id, sig_eqtl$variant_id, sep = "_"))
)

summary_tbl
```

```{r, settings, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
  Setting = c("cis-window", "Expression PCs tested", "Genotype PCs", "Metadata covariates",
              "Normalisation methods tested", "Normalisation method for results",
              "eGene FDR (qval)", "Cell types"),
  Value   = c(paste(window_kb, "kb either side of the TSS"),
              paste(exp_pcs, collapse = ", "),
              paste(geno_pc, "(see genotyping_post_impute_report.html)"),
              "PCW, sex",
              paste0(paste(sort(norm_methods), collapse = ", "), " (Level 1); ", final_norm, " (Level 2)"),
              final_norm,
              eqtl_fdr,
              sprintf("%d (Level 1 %d, Level 2 %d)", length(l1_types) + length(l2_types),
                      length(l1_types), length(l2_types)))) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Settings") |>
  gt_style()
```

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

***

```{r, benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Benchmark templates passed by the rule as rule=template pairs; expanded over the
# current cell types and settings so files from old runs are left out
bench_pairs <- strsplit(params$benchmarks, ",")[[1]]
wc_grid <- expand_grid(cell_type = c(l1_types, l2_types), norm_method = norm_methods,
                       geno_pc = geno_pc, exp_pc = exp_pcs)

benchmark_files <- tibble(rule     = sub("=.*", "", bench_pairs),
                          template = sub("^[^=]*=", "", bench_pairs)) |>
  mutate(file = map(template, ~ unique(as.character(glue::glue_data(wc_grid, .x))))) |>
  select(rule, file) |>
  unnest(file) |>
  filter(file.exists(file))   # rules not yet run are skipped

benchmarks <- benchmark_files |>
  pmap_dfr(function(rule, file) {
    df <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
    tibble(
      file = file,
      rule = rule,
      runtime_sec = df$s,
      runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
      max_rss = df$max_rss
    )
  })

summary <- benchmarks |>
  group_by(rule) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
  arrange(rule)

summary |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = "Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) |>
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) |>
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r, runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                 y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_runtime_min - sd_runtime_min, 0),
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + sd_runtime_min),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                                y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_ram_gb - sd_ram_gb, 0),
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + sd_ram_gb),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
